source.document: Honda Aiming Driving Support Systems Job Aid (June 2021, Version 9)
source.applies_to_note: All models with millimeter wave radar, FCW/LDW camera, multipurpose camera, LaneWatch camera, or BSI radar.

general_requirements: Proper wheel alignment, body structural alignment, and camera/radar alignment are critical to driving support system functions. If aiming a radar or camera is necessary due to a collision, a four-wheel alignment check must be performed first and corrected prior to aiming any camera or radar. Always refer to the model-specific service manual along with this job aid to determine when the radar or camera should be aimed.

components.location: Behind front Honda emblem, lower center of front bumper grille, or to the side behind front bumper trim (varies by model)
components.calibration_note: Requires vertical and horizontal adjustment. Adjustment performed using i-HDS scan tool and Honda special tools (Reflector Set, Alignment Set, Stand). Replacement unit must be ordered by VIN. 2022 Civic is not equipped with millimeter wave radar — driving support functions integrated into multipurpose camera.
components.trigger_lead: Aim the millimeter wave radar when any of the following apply:
triggers: Millimeter wave radar unit was removed and installed
Millimeter wave radar unit was replaced
After a collision repair that would require at least a front bumper fascia repair within 300 mm of the millimeter wave radar unit

After a collision repair requiring a structural body repair (any damage beyond minor cosmetic abrasions to the welded, riveted, or bonded parts of the main unibody, bumper reinforcements, door intrusion beams, or bolt-on front bulkheads)
After a Supplemental Restraint System (SRS) deployment
DTC P2583-54 (millimeter wave radar aiming incomplete) is set
DTC P2583-64 (millimeter wave radar aiming error) is set
DTC P2583-97 (dust or dirt on the millimeter wave radar) is set

components.calibration_note: Depending on model, requires static and/or dynamic aiming using i-HDS. Replacement windshield must be Honda genuine — aftermarket windshields will cause aiming failure or abnormal operation. Replacement camera must be ordered by VIN.
components.trigger_lead: Aim the multipurpose camera or FCW/LDW camera when any of the following apply:
triggers: Windshield was removed and installed
Windshield was replaced (replacement must be Honda genuine — aftermarket will cause aiming failure or abnormal system operation)
Multipurpose camera unit or FCW/LDW camera unit was removed and installed
Multipurpose camera unit or FCW/LDW camera unit was replaced
After a collision repair requiring a structural body repair
After a Supplemental Restraint System (SRS) deployment
DTC B2A60-52 (dynamic camera aiming incomplete) is set
DTC B2A60-54 (static camera aiming incomplete / FCW-LDW camera aiming incomplete) is set

components.location: Left and right sides of the rear body panel, behind the rear bumper (mounting position varies by model)
components.calibration_note: Static inspection using laser with targets positioned left and right rear of vehicle. If laser points within target boundaries, aim is good. If not, secondary inspection required to check radar mounting area for damage. If BSI radar unit was replaced due to damage, the BSI Radar Unit Mounting Area Check procedure must be performed before installing the new unit. 2022 Civic uses a different procedure — see Blind Spot Information (BSI) System Learning Value Reset.
components.trigger_lead: Inspect BSI radar aiming when any of the following apply:
triggers: BSI radar unit was removed and installed
BSI radar unit was replaced
After replacing or repairing the body panel(s) where the BSI radar unit is mounted
After a collision repair requiring a structural body repair at the rear of the vehicle
DTC B18B8 (left side BSI radar unit azimuth off alignment) is set
DTC B1E68 (right side BSI radar unit azimuth off alignment) is set

components.calibration_note: Static aiming using a stationary target positioned along the right-rear side of the vehicle. i-HDS not required — system uses audio/audio-navigation unit with LaneWatch camera switch.
components.trigger_lead: Aim the LaneWatch camera when any of the following apply:
triggers: LaneWatch camera unit was replaced or removed/installed
Passenger side power mirror assembly was replaced or removed/installed
Front passenger door was replaced or removed/installed
After adjusting the front passenger door
After any collision repairs to the door assembly
